title: Idle Grounds: plan
source: Source of truth: docs/Design/plan.json, edited with tools/plan/set-task.cjs.

task.in-progress: In progress: someone (an agent) is working on it now; the "now" line says who.
task.next: Next: the next thing to start.
task.todo: To do: planned and can start.
task.blocked: Blocked: cannot start; needs art, an owner answer or another task (the reason is shown).
task.waiting: Waiting: could start, but not a good time yet (the reason is shown).

milestone.done: Done: every task is done and the exit criteria hold.
milestone.in-progress: In progress: work on it is running now.
milestone.next: Next: starts as soon as the current milestone allows.
milestone.later: Later: planned for after the current ones.
milestone.waiting: Waiting: held back on purpose until something else lands.
milestone.blocked: Blocked: everything left needs an outside answer or delivery.

owners.Artist: ChatGPT via the shared Drive folder: delivers art from the art specification.

milestones.name: Unity port of the browser game
milestones.goal: Bring the whole browser prototype into Unity: every system and screen, with the world rebuilt as floating Islands joined by one-way Spirit Bridges and no offline progress.
milestones.exit: The Unity game plays like the browser version (parity audits passed) and the Island and Bridge rules of ADR 0002 and 0003 are in.

tasks.title: Port every system and screen from the HTML game
tasks.detail: The full game runs in Unity with scenes, prefabs and data assets; parity audits passed.

tasks.title: Floating islands, Spirit Bridges, no offline progress
tasks.detail: Regions became floating Islands linked by one-way bridges (ADR 0002, 0003).

milestones.name: Balance and onboarding
milestones.goal: Make the first run take about 2 to 3 hours, with machines overtaking hand work in the mid game, and teach the island and bridge ideas through quests.
milestones.exit: The playthrough bot confirms the pacing (ADR 0004) and the quests walk a new player through bridges, caravans and cross-island trade.

tasks.title: Real balance: 2-3 h first run, machines beat hands mid-game
tasks.detail: TEST mode off by default; playthrough bot checks the pacing (ADR 0004).

tasks.title: Island onboarding quests
tasks.detail: Quests that teach bridges, caravans and cross-island trade, with next-step hints.

tasks.title: Rebalance after the empty start
tasks.detail: With no starter buildings, machines out-produce hands only 3.8x mid-run (target 5-10x, ADR 0004); ending at 2:33 is still in the 2-3 h band.

milestones.name: Island requesters replace ascension (ADR 0007, accepted)
milestones.goal: Replace ascension with optional Island requesters: eleven Islands unlocked in a fixed order by tributes at the Sky-Bridge Shrine, one NPC per Island with three optional requests each, and the Heavenly Gate as the ending (ADR 0007).
milestones.exit: The game has 11 Islands, the Shrine, 11 NPCs with 33 requests, no ascension, vows or perks, and the playthrough bot finishes in about 3 hours both with and without taking requests.

tasks.title: Island requesters design (ADR 0007)
tasks.detail: Accepted 2026-10-12: 11 islands in a fixed order unlocked by tributes at the north Sky-Bridge Shrine; 11 NPCs (one per island) with 3 optional requests each; Heavenly Gate ending.

tasks.detail: Nodes, Azure Wolf, 9 buildings, 12 items, 4 NPCs; placeholder art until delivered.

tasks.title: Phase 5: balance to a ~3 h ending
